remaining_grounded_approaches.approach: Controlled CNN channel-covariance texture pooling and compact morphology fusion
remaining_grounded_approaches.source_evidence: cnn_controls.py:36 and cnn_moments.py:15–20 only concatenate per-channel means/stds. cnn_residual.py:21–24 similarly uses marginal moments. Inspected files contain no channel covariance/Gram pooling or compact-feature input to the CNN head. Existing ensemble combines predictions, not learned joint inputs.
remaining_grounded_approaches.hypothesis: Low-rank cross-channel co-occurrence could encode phase/pore/texture relationships missing from marginal moments; morphology input could condition these on size/alignment. This is untested, not an expected guaranteed gain.
remaining_grounded_approaches.bounded_design: Start with one low-rank covariance-pooling control at existing resolution/seed/folds/schedule/parameter budget; add compact input as a separate ablation only if warranted. All image/feature/target normalization fit within fold. No residual targets derived from in-sample baseline.
remaining_grounded_approaches.resources: Existing PyTorch/sklearn; sequential MPS; no new installation/data/weights. Existing128/80 fivefold78sec gives order-of-minutes reference; new structure needs benchmark. Implementation and review likely30–60min, estimates not measurements.
